_comment: FleetLink node roster (CEO order 2026-10-04; law: O-20260928-1855(3) state-plane v2, server-governance v2). Enabled nodes get poked by fleet-dispatch. Poke carries signals only - git stays the sole data channel. Adoption per machine: 1) tailscale up -> send login URL to CEO for one click (bm-b/bm-c); 2) fill host/tailnet_ip/root/repos/wake_tasks/status_files here; 3) set enabled=true; 4) run: powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File Tools\register-fleet-link.ps1 (idempotent, silent, no elevation needed - Tailscale-In firewall rules cover inbound).
